acceptanceCriteria: generate --corpus with the documented repository declared as an additional repository rederives the corpus from a supplied corpus root, proven by a test.
body: Residual of V1-2314 (PR #1494): mismatch now refuses with flowdocs-corpus-repository-mismatch; the additional-repository form is an explicit non-goal.
title: docs flows generate --corpus: accept the generated repository as an additional repository via a corpus-root input (#1479 option 1)
